name: US Steel Momentum Long/Short
description: Cross-sectional momentum long/short strategy on 4 US steel stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF). Ranks by 6-month (126-day) rate of change, goes long the top 2 and short the bottom 2, equal-weighted at 25% per position, rebalanced monthly.
source:
# US Steel Momentum Long/Short Strategy
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 4 US steel stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF)
# - Signal: 6-month momentum (126-day Rate of Change)
# - Selection: Long top 2, Short bottom 2 by momentum
# - Weighting: Equal weight within long/short portfolios (25% per stock)
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 6-month momentum (126 trading days)
momentum_6m = roc(period=126)(close)

# Cross-sectional selection: top 2 by momentum (long), bottom 2 (short)
is_top_2 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=2)(momentum_6m)
is_bottom_2 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.bottom, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=2)(momentum_6m)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals for LONG positions
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_2
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_2
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Monthly rebalance signals for SHORT positions
enter_short = is_new_month and is_bottom_2
exit_short = is_new_month and not is_bottom_2
held_short = hold_until()(enter=enter_short, exit=exit_short)

# Entry/Exit zones (long-short strategy)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Equal weight across ALL active positions (both long and short)
is_active = held_long or held_short
weights = equal_weight()(is_active)

# Position sizing - rebalance on first trading day of month
# 4 active positions → 25% each; direction from long_and_short_zone
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
